snippet.title: The Curator - A Roguelite Gallery-Management Game - Release Trailer
snippet.description: The Curator is a roguelite gallery-management game which managing your traveling art gallery. Combine the unique artwork skills, organize your collection by day, impress the picky visitors by night, and use your earnings to prepare for the next city.
